title: Finite coefficient extension preserves the normalized ordinary adjunction over any field
statement:
Let $k$ be a field, let $\ell$ be a prime invertible in $k$, and let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type $k$-morphism between separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Choose an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ and finite intermediate fields $E\subset L$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For $H=E,L$ and $W=X,Y$ use the raw rationalized categories $\mathcal C_H(W)=D^b_c(W,H)$ of [def-weil-pbc-rational-category], without a Karoubi envelope. Let $P_H$ be the rationalized completed pullback of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback], and let $D_H$ be the raw rationalized integral derived direct image of [def-weil-derived-direct-image]. Write
$$h_H:\operatorname{Hom}(P_H A,B)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Hom}(A,D_H B)$$
for the canonical adjunction identified with the ambient continuous-module derived adjunction by [lem-a1-rational-direct-image-realization, lem-per-continuous-rational-derived-realization], and $\varepsilon_H:P_HD_H\to1$ for its counit. Put $T_W=T_{L/E,W}$ and use precisely the comparisons and tensor associators of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension],
$$a:T_XP_E\xrightarrow{\sim}P_LT_Y,\qquad b:T_YD_E\xrightarrow{\sim}D_LT_X.$$
Then these specified comparisons are adjunction mates:
$$h_L^{-1}(b_B)=T_X(\varepsilon_{E,B})\circ a_{D_EB}^{-1}.$$
In particular, for $A\in\mathcal C_E(Y)$, $B\in\mathcal C_E(X)$, $u:P_EA\to B$ and $v:A\to D_EB$,
$$h_L\bigl(T_X(u)\circ a_A^{-1}\bigr)=b_B\circ T_Y\bigl(h_E(u)\bigr),$$
$$h_L^{-1}\bigl(b_B\circ T_Y(v)\bigr)=T_X\bigl(h_E^{-1}(v)\bigr)\circ a_A^{-1}.$$
The same mate equality holds in the ambient derived categories of continuous coefficient-module sheaves under the realizations $J_W$ above. Explicitly, put $R_{H,W}=\varprojlim_n(\mathcal O_H/\varpi_H^n)_W$ and $H_W=R_{H,W}[1/\varpi_H]$. Let $\widetilde P_H=H_X\otimes^L_{f^{-1}H_Y}f^{-1}(-)$ and $\widetilde D_H=Rf_{*,H}$ denote the ordinary ambient derived module operations, with adjunction $\widetilde h_H$ and counit $\widetilde\varepsilon_H$. For ambient coefficient extension $\widetilde T_W=-\otimes^L_{E_W}L_W$ with restriction $V_W$ and coefficient-adjunction unit $\eta^c_W$ [lem-pur-sheaf-ring-derived-coefficient-adjunction], let $d:V_Y\widetilde D_L\xrightarrow{\sim}\widetilde D_EV_X$ be the derived ringed-topos composition comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition]. The ambient comparison $\widetilde b_K$ is the coefficient-adjunction transpose of
$$\widetilde D_EK\xrightarrow{\widetilde D_E(\eta^c_{X,K})}\widetilde D_EV_X\widetilde T_XK\xrightarrow{d^{-1}}V_Y\widetilde D_L\widetilde T_XK,$$
and is also the ordinary pullback/direct-image mate of the inverse balanced tensor comparison $\widetilde a$. Explicitly, $\widetilde h_L^{-1}(\widetilde b_K)=\widetilde T_X(\widetilde\varepsilon_{E,K})\circ\widetilde a_{\widetilde D_EK}^{-1}$, where $\widetilde a:\widetilde T_X\widetilde P_E\xrightarrow{\sim}\widetilde P_L\widetilde T_Y$. Its restriction through $J$ is the specified $b$, with $\widetilde a$ restricting to $a$. These are equalities of coefficient-linear derived morphisms with these normalizations. The bijections $h_H$ and their inverses are $H$-linear and commute with cochain shifts under the canonical operation shift comparisons. All displayed equations respect identity extensions and successive extensions $E\subset L\subset L'$ under the tensor associators of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension].

proof.text: Because $k$ is a field it is Noetherian, so the finite-type $k$-schemes $X$ and $Y$ are Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] and finite dimensional by [lem-kun-dimension-finite-type]. Since $\ell$ is invertible in $k$ and $X,Y$ are $k$-schemes, $\ell$ is invertible on $X$ and on $Y$. These are exactly the scheme hypotheses of [def-weil-pbc-rational-category], [lem-per-continuous-rational-derived-realization] and [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]. The hypotheses of [lem-a1-rational-direct-image-realization] (a field, $\ell$ invertible in it, a morphism between separated finite-type $k$-schemes in the sense of [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]) are those of the item verbatim.

source.place: Lemma 6.7.2 and Remark 6.8.15; hypotheses checked for finite-type schemes over a field

proof.text: For each finite coefficient field $H=E,L$, form the raw integral completed pullback and direct image and then localize, exactly as in [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback], [def-weil-derived-direct-image], and [def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. The realization [lem-a1-rational-direct-image-realization] identifies these localized functors and their actual units and counits with the ambient derived-module pullback/direct-image adjunction. The continuous realization [lem-per-continuous-rational-derived-realization] identifies the pullback with $H_X\otimes^L_{f^{-1}H_Y}f^{-1}(-)$ and supplies the coefficient-extension compatibility. The integral pullback and direct-image constructions preserve shifts and triangles by [lem-cbc-completed-pullback-triangles] and [lem-pc-right-derived-functor-triangulated], and localization preserves the exact structures by [prop-weil-pbc-rational-transport].

In the ambient module categories put $\widetilde T_W=-\otimes^L_{E_W}L_W$ and let $V_W$ be restriction of scalars. The derived coefficient adjunction [lem-pur-sheaf-ring-derived-coefficient-adjunction] has unit $\eta^c_W$ given on K-flat representatives by $x\mapsto x\otimes1$. The ringed-topos composition comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition], applied to the coefficient-change and scheme morphism, supplies $d:V_Y\widetilde D_L\xrightarrow{\sim}\widetilde D_EV_X$. Thus the specified ambient $\widetilde b_K$ is the transpose of the displayed composite through $d^{-1}$, with exactly the normalization in the statement.

source.place: Lemma 6.7.2 and Remark 6.8.15; coefficient-adjunction transpose calculation

proof.text: Regard the ambient categories as derived categories of ringed topoi: $W=(X_{\mathrm{proet}},L_X)$, $X_1=(X_{\mathrm{proet}},E_X)$, $X_2=(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},L_Y)$ and $Y_0=(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},E_Y)$, with $f_1=(\mathrm{id},E_X\to L_X)$, $g_1=(f,f^{-1}E_Y\to E_X)$, $f_2=(f,f^{-1}L_Y\to L_X)$ and $g_2=(\mathrm{id},E_Y\to L_Y)$. The two composite structural maps $f^{-1}E_Y\to L_X$ coincide, since all coefficient maps are induced by the finite quotient maps, the inclusion $\mathcal O_E\subset\mathcal O_L$ and localization [lem-per-continuous-rational-derived-realization]; use the identity commutation $g_1f_1=g_2f_2$. Then $Lg_1^*=\widetilde P_E$, $Lf_2^*=\widetilde P_L$, $Lf_1^*=\widetilde T_X$ and $Lg_2^*=\widetilde T_Y$, while $Rf_{1*}=V_X$ and $Rg_{2*}=V_Y$ because restriction of scalars is exact. The canonical derived adjunction of $f_1$ (and of $g_2$) is the coefficient adjunction of [lem-pur-sheaf-ring-derived-coefficient-adjunction]: both are adjunctions $\widetilde T\dashv V$ whose unit on a flat-term K-flat complex is the class of $x\mapsto x\otimes1$, and an adjunction is determined by its unit. Form the composite adjunctions [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction] $P_1=\widetilde T_X\widetilde P_E\dashv V_1=\widetilde D_EV_X$, with counit $e_{1,Z}=\varepsilon^c_{X,Z}\circ\widetilde T_X(\widetilde\varepsilon_{E,V_XZ})$, and $P_2=\widetilde P_L\widetilde T_Y\dashv V_2=V_Y\widetilde D_L$, with counit $e_2$; the hom bijection of the second is $\widetilde h_L$ followed by the coefficient bijection on $Y$. In [lem-sfb-ringed-comparison-tensor-adjunction] the comparison $\theta:P_2\to P_1$ is, on a flat-term K-flat $E_Y$-complex $C$, the termwise identification $L_X\otimes_{f^{-1}L_Y}f^{-1}(C\otimes_{E_Y}L_Y)\cong L_X\otimes_{f^{-1}E_Y}f^{-1}C\cong(E_X\otimes_{f^{-1}E_Y}f^{-1}C)\otimes_{E_X}L_X$, so $\theta=\widetilde a^{-1}$. Its comparison $c:V_1\to V_2$, built from the two composition isomorphisms of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition], is $d^{-1}$. That lemma gives $e_{2,Z}\circ P_2(c_Z)=e_{1,Z}\circ\theta_{V_1Z}$ for every $Z$. Put $Z=\widetilde T_XK$. By Step 3, $\widetilde b_K$ is the coefficient transpose of $c_Z\circ\widetilde D_E(\eta^c_{X,K})$, so $\widetilde h_L^{-1}(\widetilde b_K)$ is its $P_2\dashv V_2$ transpose: $\widetilde h_L^{-1}(\widetilde b_K)=e_{2,Z}\circ P_2(c_Z)\circ P_2\widetilde D_E(\eta^c_{X,K})=e_{1,Z}\circ\theta_{V_1Z}\circ P_2\widetilde D_E(\eta^c_{X,K})=e_{1,Z}\circ P_1\widetilde D_E(\eta^c_{X,K})\circ\theta_{\widetilde D_EK}$, the last by naturality of $\theta$. Naturality of $\widetilde\varepsilon_E$ gives $\widetilde\varepsilon_{E,V_XZ}\circ\widetilde P_E\widetilde D_E(\eta^c_{X,K})=\eta^c_{X,K}\circ\widetilde\varepsilon_{E,K}$, hence $e_{1,Z}\circ P_1\widetilde D_E(\eta^c_{X,K})=\varepsilon^c_{X,Z}\circ\widetilde T_X(\eta^c_{X,K})\circ\widetilde T_X(\widetilde\varepsilon_{E,K})=\widetilde T_X(\widetilde\varepsilon_{E,K})$ by the triangle identity of the coefficient adjunction. Therefore $\widetilde h_L^{-1}(\widetilde b_K)=\widetilde T_X(\widetilde\varepsilon_{E,K})\circ\widetilde a_{\widetilde D_EK}^{-1}$.

source.place: Remark 6.8.15 (the pullback f^*K = f_naive^*K tensored with the coefficient sheaf, right adjoint f_*); agent-derived conjugate-comparison mate calculation

proof.text: By Step 2, $J$ identifies $h_H$ and $\varepsilon_H$ with the restrictions of $\widetilde h_H$ and $\widetilde\varepsilon_H$ [lem-a1-rational-direct-image-realization]. The finite-extension clause of [lem-per-continuous-rational-derived-realization] identifies $J_LT_{L/E}$ with $\widetilde T J_E$ and carries the pullback comparison $a$ of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension] to the balanced reassociation $\widetilde a$, all coefficient comparisons there being induced by the quotient, localization and balanced tensor maps. The finite-extension clause of [lem-a1-rational-direct-image-realization] says that the direct-image realization commutes with the coefficient comparison $b$ of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]; on the ambient side the canonical coefficient comparison is the transpose $\widetilde b$ fixed in Step 3. Hence $J$ carries both sides of $h_L^{-1}(b_B)=T_X(\varepsilon_{E,B})\circ a_{D_EB}^{-1}$ to the two sides of the ambient identity of Step 4 for $K=J_XB$. Since $J$ is an equivalence onto its image, in particular faithful, the finite-stage identity holds for every $B$.

For $u:P_EA\to B$, apply the bijection $h_L$ to $T_X(u)\circ a_A^{-1}$ and substitute the mate identity from Step 5. The defining adjunction identities $h_L(h_L^{-1}(w))=w$ and naturality in the source and target yield
$h_L(T_X(u)\circ a_A^{-1})=b_B\circ T_Y(h_E(u))$.

source.place: Lemma 6.7.2; adjunction bijection and mate equation

proof.text:
For $v:A\to D_EB$, use the inverse adjunction bijection and the same mate equality. Applying $h_L^{-1}$ to $b_B\circ T_Y(v)$ gives
$h_L^{-1}(b_B\circ T_Y(v))=T_X(h_E^{-1}(v))\circ a_A^{-1}$,
by cancellation of $h_L$ with its inverse and naturality of $T_X,T_Y$ and of $a$.

Each $D_H$ is $H$-linear: it is the scalar localization $f/\varpi^n\mapsto D(f)/\varpi^n$ of an $\mathcal O_H$-linear exact functor [prop-weil-pbc-rational-transport]. Hence $h_H(u)=D_H(u)\circ\eta_A$ is $H$-linear in $u$, and its inverse, a bijective linear map, is linear too. The shift comparisons for completed pullback and derived direct image are those of [lem-cbc-completed-pullback-triangles] and [lem-pc-right-derived-functor-triangulated], localized by [prop-weil-pbc-rational-transport]. For the ambient ringed-topos adjunctions $\widetilde P_H\dashv\widetilde D_H$, [lem-weil-pbc-derived-adjunction-shift] says that unit and counit commute with the canonical shift comparisons obtained by shifting K-flat and K-injective resolutions. Through the exact realization $J$ and the unit and counit identification of [lem-a1-rational-direct-image-realization], the finite-stage unit and counit commute with the corresponding shift comparisons, so $h_H$ and $h_H^{-1}$ commute with cochain shifts. The scalar shift comparison $\sigma$ commutes with the associators by [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]. Since the displayed equations hold for all objects, also for shifted ones, they commute with these shift comparisons.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.14 and Remark 6.8.15; shift and linearity compatibility

proof.text: For the identity extension $T_{E/E}=\mathrm{id}$, [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension] makes $a$ and $b$ identities, and every displayed equation reduces to the adjunction identity $h_E(h_E^{-1}(w))=w$. For $E\subset L\subset L'$, the same node identifies the direct comparisons $a_{L'/E}$, $b_{L'/E}$ with the two-step composites $(a_{L'/L}T_{L/E})\circ(T_{L'/L}a_{L/E})$ and $(b_{L'/L}T_{L/E})\circ(T_{L'/L}b_{L/E})$, conjugated by the associators $a_{L',L,E}$. Apply the forward equation of Step 6 for $L/E$, then for $L'/L$ with $u$ replaced by $T(u)\circ a^{-1}$; by naturality of the associators and of $a$ the composite is the forward equation for $L'/E$ after the associator identifications. The composite-mate normalization is the pasting of [lem-weil-pbc-mate-pasting], clause (1). The inverse equation and the counit normalization follow in the same way from Step 7 and Step 5; the pentagon of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension] makes the result independent of the parenthesization of longer towers. On the ambient side the same holds since [lem-a1-rational-direct-image-realization] and [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition] preserve these associators. This proves every clause, including the ambient and the raw, non-Karoubi finite-stage formulation.
